modelDescription: Toy model to verify type matching propagates across a genuine (non-composition) association. Same domain as ToyAssoc_Base, but Car's engine-related attributes have been moved to a separate FuelSystem entity, linked to Car via an explicit 'UsedFor' association (not composition/PartOf). Car itself has NO direct attributes, so its entire type-reach must come from the association. Attribute NAMES differ from the base model; attribute TYPES are identical.
